decisions.reason: It is still prominently marketed, sits close to the firm’s core camera business, and in space markets the long qualification and sales cycle means the option value likely still exceeds the cost of keeping it.
The successful ESA HERA mission reference and the fact that it is a multi-model line strongly signal realized market and technical value, so management would likely continue it.
The product remains on its own page and extends the firm’s established sensing capabilities, so its upside is still uncertain enough to justify keeping the option open.
After two years it is only lightly marketed, and with many other related development options in the portfolio management would likely redeploy resources away from this weaker LiDAR offering.
As a newly launched multi-model radiation-hard camera line closely tied to the firm’s heritage, it is too early and too strategically aligned to withdraw now.
Although still niche and only briefly marketed, it is newly launched and its potential has not fully resolved, so keeping it preserves a relatively low-cost option in a promising mission segment.
